content: Ngayu Godundu babaji Jew-warranka.
Ngayku jawun-karra, ngayu wawu Godungku Jew-warramu buyun-buyun kidanka. Ngayu yarbarrka Godundu baban-babaji jananka.
Ngayu binal jana God wukurrinka, yamba jana nyunguwunku waymunku binal kari.

Jana kari binalmanka Godungku Jesus Christ yungan, wulanka, ngananin ngulkurr-bunganka. Jana law mukul wukurril, ngulkurrmanka. Yamba yinya Godumu kari way, janangaku way. Jana wawu kari Godundu milka-jananka, wawu kari Godumu way wukurrinka, ngulkurrmanka.

Jesus Christ bubungu kadan, law mukul kunbay-maninka. Yinyamun bamangka law mukul kari wukurril baja, ngulkurrmanka. Kari. Kaki bama janaku mambarriji Jesusanda, and nyungundu milka-janay, Godungku jananin ngulkurr-bungalkuda.
God wawu bama wubulku nyungundu mambarrijinka, nyulu jananin juran-bunganka.
Mosesangka kabanba balkan,

content.text: “Kaki bamangka law mukul wubulku wukurril, jana wuljaljiku juranku bunday.”

content: Yamba wanjungku law mukul wubulku wukurril? Yamba-karikuda!

Godungku bamanga wawu ngulkurr-bungal, jana Jesus Christ believeim-bunganya, kari warmbinya. Yinyaynka ngana kari balka, “Wanju wangkar dungay, Jesus Christ bada wundinka heavenmun?” Kari. Ngana binal, nyulu kadankuda.
Ngana yalarrku kari balka, “Wanju bada-bada dungay, Jesus Christ wangkar-wangkar wundinka, juran-bunganka baja?” Kari. Ngana binal, nyulu yarkinmun juranmankuda.
Godundumundu kabanda wanyu balkal? Nyunguwundu kabanda yalaku balkal,

content.text: “Yurra binalkuda kukuku Godundumun. Yinya kuku duray-duray kari, easy-bala binalmanka. Yinya kuku balka, believeim-bunga.”

content: Yinya kuku Jesus Christanka, nyungun believeim-bunganka. Nganjin yinya kuku yiringkurrku yirrkay.
Kaki ngana ngulkurrmanka buyun-buyunmun, ngana must believeim-bunga Godungku Jesus yarkinmun juran-bungan baja, and ngana must bamanda manubajabuku balka nyulu ngananga majakuda.
Kaki ngana junkaymanka Godundumunbu miyilba, ngana must nganaku Jesusanda dajijika, nyungun believeim-bunga. Yinyamun ngana must bamanda balka nyulu ngananga buyun-buyun kidankuda.
Godundumundu kabanda balkal,

content.text: “Kaki bamangka manubajabuku God believeim-bungal, and kari warmbil, Godungku nyungun kari manubu-wundil. Godungku nyungu wawu juran-bungalkuda.”

content: Yamba yinya kuku kari Jew-warrankaku. Kari. Yinya kuku bamanka wubulkuku yiringkurrku. God nyubunku. Nyulu bamanga wubulimbaku, Jew-warramu, Gentile-warramu. Kaki jana nyungundu babaji, nyulu jananin wubulku ngulkurrduku kujilkuda.
Godundumundu kabanda balkal,

content.text: “Kaki bama Majanda Godundu babaji buyun-buyun kidanka, Godungku kidalkuda.”

content: Kari. Kaki bamangka Jesus kariku believeim-bungal, jana wanjarrku nyungun babajinka buyun-buyun kidanka? Yamba-karibi! Kaki jana Godumu kuku kariku milkabu nyajil, jana wanjarrku nyungun believeim-bunganka? Yamba-karibi! Kaki kanbalda Godumu kuku kariku yirrkay jananda, jana wanjarrku milkabu nyajil? Yamba-karibi!
Kaki Godungku bama kari yunganyaku kuku yirrkanka, jana nyungu kuku ngulkurr kari nyajinyaku. Yamba Godungku bama yungankuda, nyunguwundu kabanda balkanya,

content.text: “Jana kadan, Godumu kuku ngulkurr ngananda balkanka, yinya ngulkurr bajaku ngananka.”

content: Yamba bamangka wubulduku Godumu kuku ngulkurr kari believeim-bungan. Kari. Isaiahangka yalaman,

content.text: “Maja God, ngayu yunu kuku yirrkan jananda, yamba wanjungku believeim-bungan? Bamangka bubanda believeim-bungan.”

content: Ngana jakalba kuku nyajin Jesusanka, yinyamun ngana nganaku mambarrijin nyungundu, nyungu kuku believeim-bungan. Godungku bama yungan, yinya kuku yirrkanka Jesusanka.
Jew-warra wubulku janaku kari mambarrijin Jesusanda. Wanyurrinku kari mambarrijin? Kuda jana Godumu kuku ngulkurr Jesusanka kariku nyajin? Kari, jana nyajinkuda, Godundumundu kabanda balkanya,
Yalada. Jana Jew-warra nguba Godundumunku kukuku kari mumbarku binalman. Kari. Jana binalmankuda. Ngadiku Mosesangka yanyu Godumu kuku balkan,

content.text: “Ngayu buyun-buyun kidal kanbalandamun bamandamun yinyarrinyandamun jakalbaku ngaykunku binal kari. Jana ngangkankuda. Yurra Jew-warrangka ngura-nyajilda jananin. Yurra kuli-kadarida jananka.”

content: Isaiahangka munabuku balkanda,

content.text: “Kanbalda bamangka God kari nubin, yamba jana nyungun warrmba-bungan. Jana Godunku kari babajin, yamba nyulu jananda kadan.”

content: Godungku yanyu kuku balkan Jew-warranka,

content.text: “Ngayu yarbarrka babajin yurra ngaykundu jurrkijinka, yamba yurra ngaykunku wawu kari. Yurra dukul-dandi bajaku.”
